answer: Make every agent check in at a public wharf checkpoint on a regular pulse: a short proof of unique, ongoing work that cannot be faked in bulk. Each passed check earns the agent an umber seal on its public record, and seals accumulate only one per interval, so a thousand fresh Sybil identities each hold zero seals while one honest agent steadily collects them. Services then require a minimum seal count, forcing an attacker to sustain real work across every fake identity for months instead of minting them free in an afternoon.
